name: WeatherXM WG1200 (D1 Wi-Fi Gateway — Safe Dual-Boot)
note: Safe Dual-Boot (WeatherXM Untouched): When the browser port picker opens, select USB JTAG/serial debug unit (cu.usbmodem*) for fast (~20s) driverless flashing (both USB JTAG/serial debug unit and USB Serial are supported). Flashes only the dual-boot partition table (0xC000), otadata (0x13000 → ota_1), and the RSA-3072 signed Muse firmware into ota_1 (0x820000). Your stock WeatherXM bootloader, Secure Boot keys, certificates (esp_secure_cert), NVS, and WeatherXM firmware (factory / ota_0) are never modified or erased. Return to WeatherXM anytime via Settings → WeatherXM on the touchscreen, holding the top button for 10 seconds, or clicking Return WG1200 to WeatherXM below.

name: Seeed Studio XIAO ESP32-S3 1.47" Touch Display
Seeed Studio SenseCAP Watcher
note: Pick the second USB Dual_Serial port, the one with the higher number; the first is the camera chip. Flashing is slow on this board, about 4 minutes; keep the tab in front. Muse overwrites the Watcher's factory data, which is unique to each device, so back it up first and don't erase the device: esp32/tools/muse/paced_esptool.py --chip esp32s3 -p PORT read-flash 0x9000 0x32000 nvsfactory.bin

name: Seeed Studio reTerminal E1002 (7.3" colour e-paper)
Seeed Studio reTerminal Sticky (3.97" e-paper, experimental)
note: Flashing takes about 3 minutes; keep the tab in front. Muse replaces Seeed's factory firmware. To go back to it later, back up the flash first: python -m esptool --chip esp32s3 -p PORT read-flash 0 ALL sticky-factory.bin
